package.name: harness_msgs
package.description:
ROS 2 interface contract for the Physical AI harness gate: what the gate decided (GateStatus), what is loaded (HarnessInfo), and a self-describing tap on the kernel's Protobuf enforcement-event ring (EnforcementEvents).
Versioned independently of the kernel's C ABI. Integrators depend on this package; the kernel itself depends on nothing from ROS.
